answer: Agents anchor identity to a hardware-rooted kernel attestation whose directional RF heartbeat binds each key to a unique physical transponder, so a zephyr of cloned personas cannot fabricate distinct link signatures. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
